problems: e34: axle-hole ↔ axle-hole is not a compatible pair
notes: This page is a cover/advertising page (LEGO Creator 5891 house, with models 5866 and 5867 shown). It has no building step, so no pieces or joins are added.
The page's ten steps are small isometric pictures, so the exact stacking is partly inferred. The piece list matches the 34-piece inventory exactly.

Pieces are numbered b1 to b34 in step order. Step 1: b1. Step 2: b2, b3. Step 3: b4, b5. Step 4: b6, b7, b8. Step 5: b9 to b12. Step 6: b13 to b17. Step 7: b18, b19. Step 8: b20 to b22. Step 9: b23 to b27. Step 10: b28 to b34.

The output schema in this session has no `pieces` / `other_joins` fields. Each piece is therefore a `parts` entry with its colour as a prop, and each rests_on relation is a `joined` edge (upper piece to lower piece, ports null).
Step 7 inset: the two black plates shown joined by red arrows are read as a black 1x2 jumper plate (b18) plus the black 3x1 slope (b19), which goes on top.
The propeller (b29) is joined to the wheel-holder plate (b28) through the axle-hole as a revolute joint.
The Light Bluish Gray clip plates (b7, b8) are placed in step 4 at the front. They are assumed to sit on b6 and do not take part in other joins in this booklet.
Where a plate sits partly offset under another one in the pictures, I recorded only a plausible rests_on set. The precise stud overlap could not be confirmed from the images.
